guard: A Jcode seat gets a fresh extract of the four Cursor keys Jcode reads, through one read-only SQLite transaction in whatever journal mode Cursor uses, and every unreadable source refuses the launch before anything is written

mutations.name: Cursor's whole database is copied instead of extracted
mutations.find: for (const { entry, values } of cursorStates) publishCursorState(home, entry.destinationRelative, values);
mutations.replace: for (const { entry } of cursorStates) copyCredentialFile(home, entry.source, entry.destinationRelative);
mutations.expectRed: Cursor's state database is published as a fresh four-key extract, replacing a legacy symlink
mutations.cell: Cursor's state database is published as a fresh four-key extract, replacing a legacy symlink

mutations.name: Cursor's database is read after the other copies are written
mutations.expectRed: a header SQLite does not accept refuses as not SQLite
mutations.cell: a header SQLite does not accept refuses as not SQLite

mutations.name: a hot journal is not named
mutations.expectRed: a hot journal beside a rollback source refuses and stays in place
mutations.cell: a hot journal beside a rollback source refuses and stays in place

mutations.name: Cursor's database is opened read-write
mutations.expectRed: a hot journal beside a rollback source refuses and stays in place
mutations.cell: a hot journal beside a rollback source refuses and stays in place

mutations.name: the read does not wait for Cursor's lock
mutations.expectRed: a source locked past the 2 s bound refuses after waiting for it
mutations.cell: a source locked past the 2 s bound refuses after waiting for it

mutations.name: a non-text value is not refused
mutations.expectRed: a non-text value under a read key refuses instead of being copied
mutations.cell: a non-text value under a read key refuses instead of being copied

mutations.name: a value leaves SQLite before its type and size are checked
mutations.find: CASE WHEN typeof(value) = 'text' AND octet_length(value) <= ${CURSOR_STATE_VALUE_MAX_BYTES} THEN value END AS value
mutations.expectRed: an integer too large for a JavaScript number refuses as value_type
mutations.cell: an integer too large for a JavaScript number refuses as value_type

mutations.name: an oversized value is not refused
mutations.expectRed: an oversized value under a read key refuses instead of being truncated
mutations.cell: an oversized value under a read key refuses instead of being truncated

mutations.name: a source with none of the keys keeps the destination
mutations.expectRed: a readable source with none of the keys removes the destination
mutations.cell: a readable source with none of the keys removes the destination

mutations.name: a blank value is published
mutations.expectRed: blank values count as missing, so four of them remove the destination
mutations.cell: blank values count as missing, so four of them remove the destination

mutations.name: Cursor refusals are wrapped as private_state
mutations.expectRed: an unreadable Cursor source fails the launch with its own public code
mutations.cell: an unreadable Cursor source fails the launch with its own public code

mutations.name: the public line drops the connector-owned reason
mutations.find: writeJcodeDiagnostic(`[cotal-jcode] fatal: Jcode host startup failed (${error.code}): ${error.message}\n`);
mutations.replace: writeJcodeDiagnostic(`[cotal-jcode] fatal: Jcode host startup failed (${error.code}); inspect the private Jcode logs.\n`);
mutations.expectRed: an unreadable Cursor source fails the launch with its own public code
mutations.cell: an unreadable Cursor source fails the launch with its own public code
